subject: [PATCH 37/60] mm/page_alloc: keep private memory out of reclaim reserves

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: The patch series aims to improve memory management by excluding private memory from reclaim reserves, ensuring that general system allocations are not affected. The approach involves modifying the calculation of total reserve pages and watermark setup for zones.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series aims to improve memory management by excluding private memory from reclaim reserves, ensuring that general system allocations are not affected. The approach involves modifying the calculation of total reserve pages and watermark setup for zones, taking into account whether a node is common or private memory.
